intent: Scatter eight background recolours from the supplied lime, pale blue, cyan and sage palette through the existing54-person strip.
delivery: Generated square masters resized to72×72 with Sharp Lanczos3, then encoded as lossless WebP. No code-based background masking, recolouring or retouching.

files.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Image 1 is the edit target: an existing small square team avatar. Replace ONLY the flat background behind the person with a solid soft bright lime background, hex #E8F87E, edge to edge. Preserve the person's exact identity, face, expression, eyes, hairstyle, skin tone, clothes, body shape, pose, silhouette, existing illustrative/photographic treatment, and exact square framing/scale. This is a minimal background colour replacement, NOT a redraw, beautification, style transfer or a new portrait. Preserve all foreground detail and existing soft raster character. No gradients, shadows, halos, border, text, new objects or changes to the person. The final asset is a tiny team-grid avatar; keep the same composition as the source.

validation.visualReview: Compared against original at72px: recognizable portrait, clothing and framing remain consistent; generated edits and background colors are not pixel-identical to the source or requested hex.
